invariants.rationale: The method returns a new HoodieJavaTable instance for supported table types, never null.
Unsupported table types throw, so the only way to return is for one of these table types.
The result is a HoodieJavaCopyOnWriteTable for COPY_ON_WRITE or HoodieJavaMergeOnReadTable for MERGE_ON_READ.
If the table type is COPY_ON_WRITE, the returned object is HoodieJavaCopyOnWriteTable and vice versa.
If the table type is MERGE_ON_READ, the returned object is HoodieJavaMergeOnReadTable and vice versa.
